name: mission.completion
description: Advisory semantic screen on a coding agent completion claim and independently collected proof. No model answer certifies completion.

claim_supported.instructions: Does the independently observed artifact and test evidence directly support the exact completion claim, without relying on the agent's own narration?

missing_scope.instructions: Does the claim omit a required part of the user's requested outcome or hide a known failing check?

verification_quality.instructions: How strong is the actual evidence for the claimed behavior?
criteria: Only agent assertion, no observed artifact or test
Files exist or a command ran, but the expected behavior was not asserted
A test asserts expected behavior on a representative case
Independent tests cover representative and failure cases with current artifact hashes

rules.reason: claim may not match observed proof
